full_judgment: 3. The plaint of the plaintiffs is, in brief, that the suit property described in schedule 'Ka' and 'Kha' of the plaint originally belonged to Ambika Charan Sarker who died leaving behind 3 sons namely, Kali Charan Sarker, Upendra Nath Sarker and Nripendra Nath Sarker, as his heirs and successors in the suit land. Thereafter Kali Charan Sarker died without any issue and his other two brothers Upendra Nath Sarker and Nripendra Nath Sarker became the owners of the suit land. The RS record was prepared in the names of the said 3 (three) brothers. Thereafter, Nripendra Nath Sarker died leaving behind his only brother Upendra Nath Sarker who became the sole owner of the suit land. While Upendra Nath Sarker had been enjoying and possessing the suit land by paying rents to the Government after its mutation in his name died leaving behind the plaintiffs as his legal heirs and successors. The plaintiffs have been enjoying and possessing the suit land. The Settlement Officer on 10-4-1993 refused to record the suit land in the names of the plaintiffs in the recent Khatian saying that the suit land has been listed as vested and nonresident property and vide VP Case No.4 of 1970 it has been leased out to the father of defendant No.3 Fazal Uddin. Hence they instituted the suit for a declaration that enlistment of the suit land as enemy and vested property as illegal.
